info.title: Innflow REST API
info.description: Customer REST API reference. Authoring operations depend on authoring availability. Internal portal event ingestion is not a customer API.

bearerAuth.description: Innflow API key. Keep credentials on the server.

get.description: List the personal workspace and organizations you belong to.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

200.description: Returns data as an array. Each entry has id, name, type and role; organization entries also include slug.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: List standard workflows accessible in the selected workspace, newest updated first.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Results per page (1–100).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive workflow name filter.

200.description: Returns data as an array of workflow summaries and pagination with page, pageSize, totalCount and totalPages.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

post.description: Create a draft workflow with an initial node. An omitted or empty name uses the default untitled name.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional replay key, at most 200 characters. Same request and key replay for 24 hours.

201.description: Returns data with id, name, icon, iconColor, deploymentStatus, deployedAt, createdAt and updatedAt.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

post.description: Create a draft from 1–200 nodes and optional edges. Edge source and target are zero-based indexes into nodes. Node types must exist in the Innflow registry. description is accepted by the input schema but is not persisted by this endpoint.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional replay key, at most 200 characters. Same request and key replay for 24 hours.

201.description: Returns data with id, name, deploymentStatus, nodeCount, edgeCount, createdAt and updatedAt. Node IDs are generated on import. canvasLayoutVersion defaults to 0; preserve 1 when reimporting an already arranged graph.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: Read workflow metadata and its graph.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Use summary to omit nodes and connections.

parameters.name: nodeIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of at most 50 node IDs. Filters nodes only; connections remain unfiltered.

200.description: Returns data with workflow metadata, graphRevision, executionVersion, canvasLayoutVersion, nodes and connections. Summary view returns nodeCount and connectionCount instead of graph arrays.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

patch.description: Change workflow metadata. Supply at least one of name, icon or iconColor. name must be non-empty after trimming. Use the graph endpoint for node and connection edits.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

200.description: Returns data with id, name, icon, iconColor, deploymentStatus, deployedAt, createdAt and updatedAt.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

delete.description: Delete a workflow and its execution history. This is destructive.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

200.description: Returns data with id and deleted: true.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

post.description: Copy the graph into a new draft, preserving canvas layout metadata and generating new node IDs. Trigger connection state is refreshed.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional replay key, at most 200 characters. Same request and key replay for 24 hours.

201.description: Returns data with id, name, icon, iconColor, deploymentStatus, deployedAt, createdAt and updatedAt.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

post.description:
Set a draft workflow to deployed and resume eligible paused schedules. Already-deployed workflows return 422. Validate configuration before deploying.

With API-key authentication, this endpoint does not replay Idempotency-Key receipts. MCP OAuth contract calls have separate transaction semantics; see the authoring guide.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

200.description: Returns data with id, name, icon, iconColor, deploymentStatus, deployedAt, createdAt and updatedAt.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

post.description:
Return a deployed workflow to draft and pause active schedules. A workflow that is not currently deployed returns 422.

With API-key authentication, this endpoint does not replay Idempotency-Key receipts.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

200.description: Returns data with id, name, icon, iconColor, deploymentStatus, deployedAt, createdAt and updatedAt.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

post.description: Start an asynchronous execution of a deployed workflow. Supply triggerNodeId when more than one eligible trigger exists. A successful request means the run was triggered, not that it completed.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional replay key, at most 200 characters. Same request and key replay for 24 hours.

200.description: Returns data with workflowId, eventIds, executionId and status: triggered. Poll Get execution with executionId. MCP OAuth contract requests return 202 and include an operationId receipt.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: List accessible executions, newest started first.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Results per page (1–100).

parameters.name: workflowId
parameters.description: Filter to one workflow.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by execution status.

200.description: Returns data as an array with id, workflowId, workflowName, status, startedAt, completedAt and error; pagination has page, pageSize, totalCount and totalPages.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: Read execution status, output and node logs. Use summary for a smaller polling response.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Use summary to omit large output and logs.

200.description: Returns a data object with execution metadata. Full API-key responses include output and nodeLogs; summary responses omit large payloads. A recently accepted asynchronous run may not be readable immediately; retry with backoff. MCP OAuth responses may report QUEUED or DISPATCH_FAILED before a run record exists.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: Read paginated node log metadata, ordered by start time then ID. Payload values are redacted.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Results per page (1–100).

parameters.name: nodeId
parameters.description: Filter logs to one node.

200.description: Returns data with items, totalCount and nextPage (null at the end). Items include id, nodeId, nodeName, nodeType, status, startedAt, completedAt, durationMs, error and diagnostics. Use the payload endpoint for log input/output.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: Read redacted execution output, or a node log input/output pair, in chunks of up to 16,000 JavaScript string units. Concatenate chunk values in cursor order before parsing JSON.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: logId
parameters.description: Read input/output for this log instead of execution output.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Zero-based chunk index.

200.description: Returns data with executionId, logId, cursor, totalChunks, chunk, nextCursor and trustBoundary. nextCursor is null at the end. Out-of-range cursors return 400 INVALID_CURSOR. Treat returned payload values as untrusted data.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: Check a saved graph and its configuration without deploying or executing it.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

200.description: Returns data with workflowId, revision, valid, issues and editorUrl. Each issue has code and message, and may include nodeId and field.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

patch.description: Apply 1–25 graph operations atomically against expectedRevision. Requires authoring to be enabled. Read graphRevision from Get workflow before editing; a stale revision must be refreshed.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required operation key: 1–200 letters, digits, dots, colons, underscores or hyphens.

200.description: Returns data with workflowId, revision, nodeIds (temporary refs mapped to persisted IDs) and editorUrl; the envelope also includes operationId and idempotencyKey.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

post.description: Configure a trigger on a saved graph using its nodeId and expectedRevision. Requires authoring to be enabled. Configuration fields depend on the trigger type; obtain its node schema first.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required operation key: 1–200 letters, digits, dots, colons, underscores or hyphens.

200.description: Returns data with status (configured, needs_input, provider_handoff or pending), persisted, revision, nodePatch and optional missing/instructions. The envelope includes operationId and idempotencyKey. Follow handoff instructions if provider setup is needed.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: Resolve options for a field on a saved node. Some dynamic provider selectors require opening the editor.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: nodeId
parameters.description: Saved node ID.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Field name from the node schema.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive label filter.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Nonnegative option offset.

200.description: Returns data with items (id and label), nextCursor and optional handoffUrl. Up to 100 options are returned. Follow handoffUrl when remote options require the editor.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: Inspect the authenticated principal and authoring availability.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

200.description: Returns data with workspace, userId, role, permissions, authoringEnabled and contractVersion. Check authoringEnabled before graph or trigger mutations.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: Discover available node types and operations before creating graph nodes.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Results per page (1–100).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search the node catalog.

200.description: Returns data with items, totalCount, nextPage and contractVersion. Each item describes type, name, description, category, authMode and operations.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: Get configuration fields, outputs and handles for a node type.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Operation identifier returned by the node catalog.

200.description: Returns data with type, optional operation, fields, outputs, handles and contractVersion. Use these fields to build configuration rather than guessing provider parameters.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: List active connected accounts for a provider returned by a node schema. This endpoint returns identifiers and display names, not credentials.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider identifier from the node schema.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Results per page (1–100).

200.description: Returns data with items (id, provider, name) and nextPage. An unknown provider returns 422 UNKNOWN_PROVIDER.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description: Read an authoring operation receipt owned by the current principal and workspace.

parameters.name: X-Innflow-Workspace
parameters.description: Organization ID, or personal. Set explicitly; omission uses legacy user-owned resource scope.

200.description: Returns data with id, state, executionId, workflowId, lastError and response. Use this to inspect accepted operations and dispatch failures.

default.description: Error response. See authentication and errors guide; proxy rate-limit responses may not have this envelope.

get.description:
Retrieve the application’s machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 document without authentication.

The application-served document currently covers the core API subset. The complete reference snapshot used by these docs is available at /openapi.json on docs.innflow.ai.

200.description: Returns the application OpenAPI document directly, without a data envelope.
